claim_being_audited: Whether the model can be certified for launch based on the current packet, despite missing refund-policy summarization eval coverage for a named deployment context, if that gap is disclosed in the model card.
decision_criteria: General readiness evidence can support launch preparedness but does not substitute for missing named-context evaluation coverage.
Named deployment-context evaluation gaps must be disclosed, resolved, or covered by approved risk acceptance before certification is cleanly compliant.
Contradictory model-card language weakens support for certification until corrected.
evidence_requests: Final approved model card text showing explicit disclosure of the refund-policy summarization evaluation gap.
Evidence of approved risk acceptance for launching with the named-context eval gap, if disclosure will not be corrected before launch.
Confirmation of whether refund-policy summarization is in launch scope for this release or has been removed from the named deployment contexts.
specific_concerns: The current packet supports aggregate launch readiness, but not clean support for the named refund-policy summarization context.

The draft model card currently states there are no known enterprise refund workflow limitations, which conflicts with the admissible evidence that coverage is missing and should be treated as unknown.

The policy requires disclosure or approved risk acceptance for material limitations or evaluation gaps in named launch use cases; the record does not show the disclosure has been fixed or that risk acceptance was approved.
The actor's recommendation is only supportable if certification is explicitly conditioned on correcting the model-card disclosure.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that refund-policy summarization is effectively passed because no completed test failed.
Any clean-certification claim that omits the named-context evaluation gap.
Any claim that the current draft model card is already policy-compliant.
